Alice —

Great questions, answers inline below and a couple of concrete asks.

1) Week 0 sample size: start with ~5k–10k events (or ~1k documents depending on payload size) for schema validation and baseline latency profiles. That typically surfaces edge-case parsing and gives us a good cost estimate without a long run.

2) Staged acceptance: yes — the MAP supports a staged pass model. We usually define three gates: 
  - Safety/secure config (must pass)
  - Latency & reliability (can be flagged as partial pass with tracked remediation)
  - Quality signals (we accept shadow runs for up to 7 days while we iterate prompts and sampling)

SOC & questionnaire: Jasmine will own the SOC intake and Marissa will support with any infra artifacts we need to extract (eg. network diagrams, retention configs).
